Governance controls Chinese public security authorities investigated the origin of the images and traced them to their original source. The Qinghai user responsible for linking the AI images to earthquake disaster information was detained by local public security authorities on administrative grounds.

AII-1002-60469: More than 150 Motorola ALPR cameras exposed live video feeds and detailed vehicle records to the public internet without authentication, according to security researcher Matt Brown who discovered the flaw after purchasing an ALPR camera on eBay and reverse engineering it. AII-1001-98387: Southern California Edison's internal wildfire forecasts underestimated the potential size of the Eaton Canyon fire in Los Angeles by a factor of ten in the days leading up to the January wildfire threat, according to documents reviewed by Reuters. Reported impact The Eaton fire destroyed around 9,400 homes and buildings and killed 17 civilians, making it the centerpiece of one of the costliest natural disasters in US history. Dr Joseph Mitchell, a scientist and wildfire expert witness for California utility regulators, said SCE's predictions missed the mark mainly because its models were only running simulations that extend eight hours after an ignition, with bulk of damage occurring well after that period. Governance controls SCE defended its modeling capabilities and said the cause and circumstances around the fire are under investigation. SCE told Reuters it would evaluate whether to use longer fire simulation periods. Raymond Fugere, SCE's asset intelligence director, said variations in wind patterns and available fuels in hard-hit areas may not have been fully accounted for in the fire spread modeling.

AII-1002-60863: On January 6, 2025, the Chilean Supreme Court upheld a protection order brought by lawyer Rodrigo Lagos, who reported that Worldcoin scanned the iris of his 17-year-old daughter without parental consent, violating her privacy and fundamental rights. AII-1002-60497: Mike Johns, a Los Angeles-based businessman, was a passenger in a Waymo autonomous taxi travelling to Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport on a Monday when the vehicle became stuck circling repeatedly around a roundabout in an airport parking lot. AII-1002-60421: Users on Xiaohongshu shared posts claiming to use ChatGPT and AI software to predict lottery numbers. A journalist verified that three lottery number combinations generated by AI software did not win any prizes when tested with 12 yuan of lottery purchases on January 7. AII-1002-60323: Instagram's 'sensitive content' filter blocked search results and hashtags related to LGBTQ+ communities from users with the filter enabled, including all teen accounts where the setting is turned on automatically. AII-1002-60313: xAI announced plans to expand its Memphis Colossus supercomputer facility from 100,000 GPUs to 1 million GPUs, a 900% increase. AII-1002-60263: A deepfake video using the likeness of Sir Jim Mann, an endocrinologist at the University of Otago, was posted to a Facebook page for Smart Hemp Gummies. Mann advised people to verify information directly from reliable sources and to be skeptical of health claims that sound too good to be true.

AII-1002-60361: On January 5, 2025, a netizen used AI technology to create fake images and videos by combining old photos from the internet, then posted false information about an earthquake in Maigaiti County in Kashgar, Xinjiang, featuring footage of buildings shaking violently and residents fleeing in panic. AII-1002-60253: Police in Hong Kong dismantled a criminal syndicate that exploited deepfake technology and dating apps to defraud victims in Taiwan, Singapore, and Malaysia of over HK$34 million.
